headings.usage: Use for all massive hero text and section titles. Creates the 'Masters' Union' Old-Money Authority feel.

body_and_data.usage: Use for body text, ticker tapes, price metrics, and UI labels. Brings the 'Trading Terminal' precision.

rules: H1 up to text-5xl md:text-6xl+ with tracking-tighter.
Metrics and labels must use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em].
No full-screen gradients. Only use black and white structurally.
Green and Red are reserved strictly for 3D market elements and market data accents.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Use a fixed SVG noise overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 20%) to kill digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.magnetic_buttons: Framer motion scale and translate on hover with a 1px border-white/20.

3d_architecture.setup: Use a fixed full-screen R3F <Canvas> wrapping <ScrollControls pages={6} damping={0.2}>. Put HTML content inside <Scroll html style={{width: '100vw'}}> and 3D scenes alongside it inside the canvas. The canvas should be fixed in the background (z-[-1]).
3d_architecture.lighting: Use <Environment preset='city' /> for realistic reflections on candlesticks. Add low-intensity ambient light.

scroll_choreography.0_to_20_Hero: Camera glides through a dense 'forest' of floating red and green 3D candlesticks. Candlesticks have meshStandardMaterial with high metalness.
scroll_choreography.20_to_40_Why: Camera rotates downwards 90 degrees to view a glowing market grid terrain (wireframe plane).
scroll_choreography.40_to_60_Courses: Two massive glass-like price pillars rise from the grid, camera orbits them slowly.
scroll_choreography.60_to_80_Mentor: Candlesticks morph and spiral into an abstract data ring surrounding the mentor section.
scroll_choreography.80_to_100_FAQ_CTA: Camera pulls way back, elements dissolve into a minimalist glowing sphere or logo.

3d_architecture.implementation_rule: Use useScroll() from @react-three/drei. Update camera positions and object rotations inside useFrame() based on scroll.offset.

layouts_and_grids.general: Padding: Generous use of p-12, py-24, py-32. Content constrained to max-w-7xl.
layouts_and_grids.why_section: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8, col-span-4 to avoid perfect symmetry.
layouts_and_grids.courses_section: 2-Column Grid for pricing cards. Apply 3D tilt effect on hover via framer-motion (useMotionValue, useTransform).
layouts_and_grids.mentor_section: Asymmetric layout. Mentor image left (grayscale), massive Bodoni typography right.

mentor_portrait.description: Black and white portrait of mentor. Use in Mentor section.

offline_classroom.description: Modern business school classroom. Use as background for offline course card.

market_texture.description: Stock market abstract texture. Use sparingly in overlays or footer.

components.ticker_tape: Use react-fast-marquee. 'Editorial Ribbon' style: JetBrains Mono text-sm, pale text on void background, gap-24, very slow smooth drift.
components.accordion_faq: Minimalist borders. border-b border-white/10 only. No backgrounds. Expands with framer-motion AnimatePresence.
components.pricing_cards: Use 'Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant)'. backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10. Add 3D Tilt.

accessibility_and_performance.testing: All interactive elements (Enroll buttons, FAQ toggles) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='enroll-online-button').
accessibility_and_performance.contrast: Ensure text over 3D scenes is readable. Apply text-shadow or a glass scrim layer behind text blocks. DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
accessibility_and_performance.performance: Limit the number of 3D objects (candlesticks). Use InstancedMesh in R3F if rendering >100 candles. Wrap 3D components in React.Suspense.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions for all files, not .tsx.
Checkout pages (BuyCourse / Payment Result) MUST NOT BREAK. Do not inject heavy 3D canvases into the checkout flow. Keep it clean and readable.
Use Framer Motion for UI animations (magnetic buttons, page transitions, entering cards).
Use pure Tailwind CSS for structural grid layouts; Shadcn for complex interactives (like FAQ) but heavily customized with Tailwind to remove default Vercel look.
Ensure HTML overlays in ScrollControls are properly styled with pointer-events: auto where clicks are needed.
CRITICAL: The checkout and enrollment flows must remain untouched conceptually, just styled consistently.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
